# QnALog 1.5.0

QnALog now preserves original note text as a restorable snapshot and supports switching between the source note and generated versions.

## Changes

- Save and register an original-source snapshot before creating a repolished derived note.
- Show the saved original in the sidebar and allow switching back to its note content and original transcript.
- Read hidden version manifests and snapshots through the Vault adapter, so recovery does not depend on Obsidian indexing hidden paths.
- Strengthen version metadata validation and verify cache writes before changing the active version.
- Improve generated clean-copy and derived-note version handling.

## User impact

- No settings schema, API key, provider configuration, or device-selection changes.
- Existing notes are not rewritten in bulk. A snapshot is created when a note is processed by the relevant version workflow.
- Generated derived notes remain separate Markdown files; switching a version updates the source note's displayed content while retaining its original transcript.
